content.text: {"label":"outage","confidence":"high","explanation":"The IMPS/NEFT payment hub fault (INC-20261112-1271, P2, opened 11:58) left fund transfers stuck as pending even though the money had left customers' accounts. Payments calls jumped to 212-229 per 15 minutes against a forecast of about 100 (+112% to +134%). The extra calls were mainly payment_status_enquiry (2.77x normal) and refund_status (2.42x normal). The incident is now resolved and calls are almost back to forecast (91 vs 85.8 at 13:30), with service level at 100% since 13:00.","evidence":[{"source":"incident","ref_id":"INC-20261112-1271","summary":"P2, IMPS/NEFT payment hub, opened 11:58: transfers stuck pending, account debited but credit not confirmed; now resolved."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"payment_status_enquiry","summary":"543 calls vs 196.1 expected (+346.9, 2.77x normal) across 11:45-13:30."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"refund_status","summary":"365 calls vs 150.9 expected (+214.1, 2.42x normal), in line with debited-but-not-credited transfers."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"volume","summary":"Peak of 212-229 calls per interval vs about 100 forecast from 11:45-12:15, falling to 91 vs 85.8 by 13:30."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"service_level","summary":"Service level fell to 4.7-29.5% with 84 abandons at 11:45, then recovered to 95-100% once staffing was raised to 45-55 agents."}],"flagged_injections":[]}
